mentions.heading: Separation from Versigent may not qualify as tax-free
mentions.detail: IRS could deem Versigent Separation taxable under Section 355; subsidiaries and U.S. holders face significant tax liabilities
mentions.quote: In addition, certain of our subsidiaries could be subject to U.S. federal income tax if the Separation and/or certain related transactions were determined not to qualify for non-recognition under Section 355 and related provisions of the Code. These amounts could be material, and could adversely affect our business, financial conditions, cash flows and results of operations.

mentions.heading: Versigent may fail to meet Tax Matters Agreement indemnification
mentions.detail: Reliance on Versigent indemnity under Tax Matters Agreement for taxes if its representations or covenants breached
mentions.quote: However, if Versigent fails to satisfy its indemnification obligations to us in respect of such taxes and expenses, our business, financial condition, cash flows and results of operations could be adversely affected.

mentions.heading: Any changes in consumer credit availability or cost of borrowing could adversely affect our business.
mentions.detail: Reduced consumer credit and higher borrowing costs depress global automotive sales and customer production volumes
mentions.quote: Declines in the availability of consumer credit and increases in consumer borrowing costs have negatively impacted global automotive sales and resulted in lower production volumes in the past.

mentions.heading: Banking sector volatility may impair credit availability
mentions.detail: Recent U.S. financial institution volatility hurt equity and credit markets; recurrence could restrict consumer credit
mentions.quote: Any reoccurrence of these conditions has the potential to adversely impact consumer credit availability or the cost of borrowing, which in turn could adversely impact our business.

mentions.heading: We may lose or fail to attract and retain key salaried employees and management personnel.
mentions.quote: The loss of the services of any member of senior management or a key salaried employee could have an adverse effect on our business.
